snippet.title: 「Calice」八月に紛れて Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
【Download】
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/calice/id1562692963
Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Ra8bit.Calice

【Information】
Track Name: 八月に紛れて
Composer: Carnival
Illustrator: Rimer Ku
Animator: ACG EDIT

【Calice】
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ra8bitstudio
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ra8bitstudio
Discord: https://discord.gg/TvAUEBqjr9 
Ra:8bit Studio: http://ra8bitstudio.com/
Contact: ra8bitstudio[at]gmail.com

【About】
由獨立小團隊「Ra:8bit Studio」開發的浮動判定音樂遊戲「Calice」。
是一款以「 讓不同玩家都能感受到音遊的樂趣 」為創作理念的手機音樂遊戲。
將帶給各位一趟全新的旅程一探由各式各樣的音樂所組成的世界。

Calice, presented to you by the independent development team Ra:8bit Studio - 
aims to bring everyone the excitement of rhythm games.
Dive into a world composed of all kinds of music - a journey awaits.

© 2021 Ra:8bit Studio. All rights reserved. 

#Calice
